messages:
tara: Rolling out 'slim-prefetch' to canary pools now. Quick wins: p50 ~10% lower, p99 ~19% lower on chat traces and ~7% token cost reduction. No model changes, just smarter lightweight prefetch + microbatch tweak. :rocket:

deploy-bot: canary snapshot (canary-21 -> prod):
- p50: 95ms -> 86ms (-9.5%)
- p99: 430ms -> 349ms (-18.9%)
- token cost: $0.0095 -> $0.0088 (-7.4%)
- errors: 0.02% -> 0.021% (within normal variance)

joel: Nice. Which pools are in canary? any opt-out behavior for Dedicated tenants?

tara: Canary on gpu-us-west-2a + gpu-eu-central-1a. Default ON for hosted and Dedicated, but tenants can set `runtime.disable_slim_prefetch=true` to opt out. Runbook updated: https://go/redwood/runbooks/slim-prefetch (internal).

ana: What's the mechanism in one line? so I can tell CS folks.

tara: Microbatcher adds a micro-hold (<=6ms) when prefix-match prob is high, and prefetch uses a tiny in-process shadow index for very-hot prefixes to avoid remote KV hop. Combined reduces stalls and avoids large batching delays.

sre-bot: health-check command used during canary:
```
# compare p99 by pool between canary and prod
python infra/metrics_diff.py --metric p99_latency --from canary-21 --to prod --group pool
```

mike: please push a one-liner to #ops and #customer-success with metrics + opt-out link. I'll watch the dashboards for the next 30m.

tara: Draft for ops/CS: "Deployed slim-prefetch: p50 ~-10%, p99 ~-19%, token cost ~-7%. Opt-out: runtime.disable_slim_prefetch=true. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/slim-prefetch" :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: feature `runtime.slim_prefetch` enabled on canary pools. Rolling to more pools in 20m if green.

tara: Huge thanks to microbatch + kv-prefetch teams. Will post a brief follow-up with histograms and cost breakdowns.
